name: Komborero Tea Room
bio: A small-batch tea room and kitchen in Avondale. We roast our own coffee, bake every morning, and plate nostalgic Zimbabwean comfort food the way your aunt would: generous, unhurried, and always with seconds offered.

blocks.tagline: Small-batch coffee, morning bakes & plates that remember home
blocks.hero: Roasted in the courtyard, baked before sunrise. Our Avondale tea room serves slow mornings, honest plates and the kind of coffee people cross town for.
blocks.services:
Fresh roast coffee & loose-leaf tea
Morning bakes: vetkoek, scones & rusks
All-day breakfast & light lunches
Event platters & office catering
Preserves, chutneys & takeaway blends

faq.q: Can I order ahead on WhatsApp?
faq.a: Yes — send us your order on WhatsApp before 10:30 and it will be packed and waiting at the counter. Larger platters need a day's notice.
There is free street parking along King George Road and a small gravel lot behind the building, shared with the florist next door.
We deliver coffee beans and preserves across Harare's northern suburbs on Fridays. Hot food is collection-only for now.
We cater up to 60 guests — teas, platters and dessert tables. Message us at least 48 hours ahead so we can plan the menu with you.

testimonials.comment: The mbuya roast is the best cup of coffee I've had in Harare, and the vetkoek was still warm at 8am.
testimonials.name: Ropafadzo M.

testimonials.comment: Ordered platters for my mum's retirement do — delivered on time, beautifully arranged, and everyone asked who catered.
testimonials.name: Tinashe C.

testimonials.comment: Lovely quiet garden seating and honest prices. It does get busy on Saturdays after 10, so come early.
testimonials.name: Chipo N.

testimonials.comment: The chilli chutney alone is worth the drive across town. I buy three jars at a time.
testimonials.name: Blessing K.
